## Why this notebook exists

Unit tests cover construction, parent masks, and synthetic recovery. This notebook
adds **application-scale** probes: large and wide panels, an AgeSCM-pattern Lux
1D-CNN encoder stub, ODE residuals under `do`, generative L3 abduction, and a
Phase 1→2b hand-off ledger.

Estimation on codes (mediation / LMTP / missing $Y$) is in the sibling
[CausalTargeted deep_scm_estimation_stress.qmd](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl/blob/main/docs/stress/deep_scm_estimation_stress.qmd).

Out of scope: UniversalDiffEq hard wiring, Flux-in-core, non-additive image DeepSCM,
full MIRS cohort files.

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-audit-helpers

const RESULTS = NamedTuple{(:section, :estimand, :expected, :actual, :abs_err, :ok, :note),
    Tuple{String, String, Float64, Float64, Float64, Bool, String}}[]
const TIMINGS = NamedTuple{(:section, :seconds), Tuple{String, Float64}}[]

function record!(section, estimand; expected, actual, tol = nothing, note = "")
    e = Float64(expected)
    a = Float64(actual)
    err = abs(a - e)
    ok = tol === nothing ? isfinite(a) : (err <= Float64(tol))
    push!(RESULTS, (string(section), string(estimand), e, a, err, ok, string(note)))
    return (; err, ok)
end

function timed!(f::Function, section::AbstractString)
    t0 = time()
    out = f()
    elapsed = time() - t0
    push!(TIMINGS, (section = string(section), seconds = elapsed))
    println("⏱ ", section, ": ", round(elapsed; digits = 3), " s")
    return out
end

nothing
```

## Part A — Representation scale and CNN stub

### Large $n \\times p$ linear encode

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-large-encode
#| warning: false

rng = Random.Xoshiro(99)
n_big, p_big, d_big = 2_500, 128, 4
Xbig = randn(rng, n_big, p_big)
Bbig = randn(rng, p_big, d_big) ./ sqrt(p_big)
names = [Symbol("z$j") for j in 1:d_big]
spec_lin = RepresentationSpec(:S, names, S -> S * Bbig; role = :measurement)

panel_big = timed!("large_encode") do
    encode_to_panel(
        Xbig, spec_lin;
        tabular = Dict(:A => rand(rng, n_big), :Y => randn(rng, n_big)),
    )
end
@assert length(panel_big[:z1]) == n_big
@assert eltype(panel_big[:z1]) === Float64
@assert panel_big[:z1] ≈ (Xbig * Bbig)[:, 1] rtol = 1e-10
t_large = only(t.seconds for t in TIMINGS if t.section == "large_encode")
@assert t_large < 5.0
record!(:large_encode, "elapsed_s"; expected = 0.0, actual = t_large, tol = 5.0,
    note = "soft wall-clock")
println("large encode OK; elapsed=", round(t_large; digits = 3), " s")
```

### AgeSCM-pattern Lux 1D-CNN encoder

Synthetic bump spectra: latent $M^*$ embedded in a smooth peak; CNN maps
$S \\mapsto z$ (definitional codes).

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-cnn-encode
#| warning: false

rng_c = Random.Xoshiro(11)
n_c, p_c, d_c = 200, 64, 1
A_c = Float64.(rand(rng_c, n_c) .< 0.5)
W_c = randn(rng_c, n_c)
Mstar = 1.2 .* A_c .+ 0.4 .* W_c .+ 0.35 .* randn(rng_c, n_c)
grid = range(0, 1; length = p_c)
bump = exp.(-((collect(grid) .- 0.4) ./ 0.08) .^ 2)
S_c = randn(rng_c, n_c, p_c) .* 0.15
for i in 1:n_c
    S_c[i, :] .+= Mstar[i] .* bump
end

_, nn_cnn, ps_cnn, st_cnn = make_cnn_encoder(
    p_c, d_c; hidden_ch = 4, kernel = 5, rng = Random.Xoshiro(12),
)

function cnn_loss(ps)
    X = reshape(Float32.(transpose(S_c)), p_c, 1, n_c)
    Y, _ = Lux.apply(nn_cnn, X, ps, st_cnn)
    return sum(abs2, Float64.(vec(Array(Y))) .- Mstar) / n_c
end

before_cnn = timed!("cnn_loss_before") do
    cnn_loss(ps_cnn)
end

after_cnn = timed!("cnn_train") do
    optf = OptimizationFunction((ps, _) -> cnn_loss(ps), Optimization.AutoFiniteDiff())
    sol = solve(
        OptimizationProblem(optf, ps_cnn),
        OptimizationOptimisers.Adam(0.05);
        maxiters = 150,
    )
    ps_cnn .= sol.u
    sol.objective
end
@assert after_cnn < before_cnn

encode_trained = S -> begin
    n, p_in = size(S)
    X = reshape(Float32.(transpose(S)), p_in, 1, n)
    Y, _ = Lux.apply(nn_cnn, X, ps_cnn, st_cnn)
    Float64.(transpose(Array(Y)))
end
spec_cnn = RepresentationSpec(
    :spectrum, [:z1], encode_trained; role = :definitional,
)
cert_cnn = representation_certificate(spec_cnn)
@assert cert_cnn.role === :definitional
panel_cnn = encode_to_panel(
    S_c, spec_cnn; tabular = Dict(:A => A_c, :W => W_c, :Y => 1.5 .* Mstar .+ 0.3 .* W_c),
)
ρ = cor(panel_cnn[:z1], Mstar)
@assert ρ > 0.7
@assert after_cnn < before_cnn
@assert after_cnn / before_cnn < 0.25
record!(:cnn_encode, "cor_z_Mstar"; expected = 0.85, actual = ρ, tol = 0.2,
    note = "AgeSCM-pattern Lux CNN")
record!(:cnn_encode, "loss_before"; expected = before_cnn, actual = before_cnn, tol = 0.0,
    note = "pre-train MSE to M*")
record!(:cnn_encode, "loss_after"; expected = 0.0, actual = after_cnn, tol = 0.2,
    note = "post-train MSE to M*")
record!(:cnn_encode, "loss_ratio"; expected = 0.0, actual = after_cnn / before_cnn, tol = 0.25,
    note = "after/before (want ≪ 1)")
println("CNN codes cor(z, M*)=", round(ρ; digits = 3),
    " loss ", round(before_cnn; digits = 3), " → ", round(after_cnn; digits = 3),
    " (ratio ", round(after_cnn / before_cnn; digits = 3), ")")
```

```{julia}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Trained CNN codes versus latent mediator M* (definitional representation)."

fig = Figure(size = (520, 360))
ax = CairoMakie.Axis(fig[1, 1]; xlabel = "M*", ylabel = "z1", title = "CNN stub codes")
scatter!(ax, Mstar, panel_cnn[:z1]; markersize = 6, color = (:steelblue, 0.6))
```

### Small-$n$ conservation scale

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-small-n-encode
#| warning: false

rng_s = Random.Xoshiro(21)
n_s, p_s = 48, 32
Ms = randn(rng_s, n_s)
bump_s = exp.(-((collect(range(0, 1; length = p_s)) .- 0.5) ./ 0.1) .^ 2)
Ss = randn(rng_s, n_s, p_s) .* 0.2
for i in 1:n_s
    Ss[i, :] .+= Ms[i] .* bump_s
end
enc_s, _, ps_s, st_s = make_cnn_encoder(p_s, 1; rng = Random.Xoshiro(22))
# freeze random CNN; matched-filter baseline for comparison
z_filter = Ss * bump_s
z_cnn = enc_s(Ss)[:, 1]
@assert all(isfinite, z_cnn)
@assert length(z_cnn) == n_s
record!(:small_n, "cnn_finite"; expected = 1.0, actual = Float64(all(isfinite, z_cnn)),
    tol = 0.0)
record!(:small_n, "filter_cor"; expected = 0.9, actual = cor(z_filter, Ms), tol = 0.15)
println("small-n encode OK; filter cor=", round(cor(z_filter, Ms); digits = 3))
```

## Part B — Mechanisms, `do`, and L3

### ODE residual + `do_pin`

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-ode-residual
#| warning: false

rng_o = Random.Xoshiro(7)
spec_ode = ContinuousCDMSpec(
    [:z, :x, :y];
    parents = Dict(:z => Symbol[], :x => [:z, :x], :y => [:x, :y]),
)
lib_ode = mechanism_library_from_cdm(spec_ode)
attach_lux_mechanism!(
    lib_ode, :x; parents = [:z], hidden = 4, kind = :ode_residual, rng = rng_o,
)

function known_rhs!(du, u, p, t)
    z, x, y = u
    du[1] = -0.1 * z
    du[2] = -0.2 * x
    du[3] = -0.1 * y + 0.4 * x
    return nothing
end
rhs! = build_ode_rhs(known_rhs!, spec_ode, lib_ode)

function true_rhs!(du, u, p, t)
    z, x, y = u
    du[1] = -0.1 * z
    du[2] = -0.2 * x + 0.5 * z
    du[3] = -0.1 * y + 0.4 * x
    return nothing
end
u0 = [2.0, 0.5, 0.0]
tspan = (0.0, 5.0)
t_obs = 0.0:0.25:5.0
data = Array(solve(ODEProblem(true_rhs!, u0, tspan), Tsit5(); saveat = t_obs))

loss_ode = function (_ps)
    pred = solve(
        ODEProblem(rhs!, u0, tspan, nothing), Tsit5();
        saveat = t_obs, abstol = 1e-6, reltol = 1e-6,
    )
    try
        return sum(abs2, Array(pred) .- data)
    catch
        return 1e6
    end
end

before_ode = loss_ode(nothing)
timed!("ode_train") do
    train_mechanisms!(lib_ode; loss = loss_ode, maxiters = 150, lr = 0.05)
end
after_ode = loss_ode(nothing)
@assert after_ode < before_ode
sol_do = solve_cdm(
    spec_ode, rhs!, u0, tspan, nothing;
    intervention = do_pin(:z, 1.0),
)
z_end = sol_do.u[end][spec_ode.index[:z]]
@assert z_end ≈ 1.0 atol = 1e-8
record!(:ode_residual, "loss_after"; expected = 0.0, actual = after_ode, tol = max(2.0, 0.5 * before_ode),
    note = "recovery progress")
record!(:ode_residual, "do_pin_z"; expected = 1.0, actual = z_end, tol = 1e-6)
println("ODE loss ", round(before_ode; digits = 3), " → ", round(after_ode; digits = 3),
    "; do(z=1) terminal z=", round(z_end; digits = 4))
```

### Generative L3 (scalar)

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-l3-scalar
#| warning: false

rng_l = Random.Xoshiro(9)
lib_l3 = MechanismLibrary(;
    allowed_parents = Dict(:x => Symbol[], :y => [:x]),
)
attach_lux_mechanism!(
    lib_l3, :y; parents = [:x], hidden = 8, kind = :generative, rng = rng_l,
)
m_y = lib_l3.mechanisms[:y]
xs = range(-1.5, 1.5; length = 40)
loss_l3 = function (_ps)
    s = 0.0
    for x in xs
        s += abs2(generate_from_noise(m_y, 0.0, [x]) - 2x)
    end
    return s / length(xs)
end
timed!("l3_train") do
    train_mechanisms!(lib_l3; loss = loss_l3, maxiters = 400, lr = 0.08)
end
m_y = lib_l3.mechanisms[:y]
after_l3 = loss_l3(nothing)
@assert after_l3 < 0.05

# Additive-noise algebra is exact for any attached f
for x in (-1.0, 0.0, 1.2), u in (-0.5, 0.0, 0.4)
    y = generate_from_noise(m_y, u, [x])
    @assert abduce_noise(m_y, y, [x]) ≈ u atol = 1e-10
end

x_f, u_true = 1.0, -0.3
# Factual under the learned mechanism (L3 abduction is model-relative)
y_f = generate_from_noise(m_y, u_true, [x_f])
u_hat = abduce_noise(m_y, y_f, [x_f])
y_cf = mechanism_counterfactual(m_y, y_f, [x_f], [0.0])
@assert u_hat ≈ u_true atol = 1e-10
@assert y_cf ≈ generate_from_noise(m_y, u_true, [0.0]) atol = 1e-10
f1 = generate_from_noise(m_y, 0.0, [x_f])
record!(:l3_scalar, "abduce_U"; expected = u_true, actual = u_hat, tol = 1e-8)
record!(:l3_scalar, "cf_do_x0"; expected = generate_from_noise(m_y, u_true, [0.0]), actual = y_cf, tol = 1e-8)
record!(:l3_scalar, "f_at_1_vs_2"; expected = 2.0, actual = f1, tol = 0.35)
record!(:l3_scalar, "train_loss"; expected = 0.0, actual = after_l3, tol = 0.05)

g = DiGraph(2)
add_edge!(g, 1, 2)
scm = graphscm_with_mechanisms(
    g,
    Dict{Int, Function}(1 => (u,) -> u, 2 => (x, u) -> 0.0),
    Set{Int}(),
    lib_l3;
    node_names = Dict(1 => :x, 2 => :y),
)
U = Dict(1 => 1.0, 2 => u_hat)
fact = simulate_scm(scm, U)
cf = simulate_scm(counterfactual_graph(scm, do_intervention(1, 0.0)), U)
record!(:l3_scalar, "twin_factual"; expected = y_f, actual = fact[2], tol = 0.35)
record!(:l3_scalar, "twin_cf"; expected = y_cf, actual = cf[2], tol = 0.35)
println("L3 abduce U≈", round(u_hat; digits = 3), " CF≈", round(y_cf; digits = 3),
    " f(1)≈", round(f1; digits = 3))
```

### Multi-dim codes L3 ($d=3$)

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-l3-multidim
#| warning: false

rng_m = Random.Xoshiro(12)
lib_m = MechanismLibrary(;
    allowed_parents = Dict(:x => Symbol[], :y => [:x]),
)
attach_lux_mechanism!(
    lib_m, :y;
    parents = [:x], hidden = 6, kind = :generative, output_dim = 3, rng = rng_m,
)
m3 = lib_m.mechanisms[:y]
xs3 = range(-1.0, 1.0; length = 30)
loss_m = function (_ps)
    s = 0.0
    for x in xs3
        ŷ = generate_from_noise(m3, zeros(3), [x])
        s += sum(abs2, ŷ .- [x, 2x, -x])
    end
    return s / length(xs3)
end
before_m = loss_m(nothing)
timed!("l3_multidim_train") do
    train_mechanisms!(lib_m; loss = loss_m, maxiters = 300, lr = 0.05)
end
@assert loss_m(nothing) < before_m
u3 = [0.1, -0.2, 0.05]
y3 = generate_from_noise(m3, u3, [0.8])
@assert abduce_noise(m3, y3, [0.8]) ≈ u3 atol = 1e-10
y3_cf = mechanism_counterfactual(m3, y3, [0.8], [0.0])
@assert y3_cf ≈ generate_from_noise(m3, u3, [0.0]) atol = 1e-10
record!(:l3_multidim, "roundtrip_err"; expected = 0.0,
    actual = norm(abduce_noise(m3, y3, [0.8]) .- u3), tol = 1e-9)
println("multi-dim L3 OK")
```

### Phase 1 codes → generative L3 hand-off

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-phase1-hand-off
#| warning: false

rng_h = Random.Xoshiro(33)
n_h, p_h, d_h = 80, 16, 2
Xh = randn(rng_h, n_h, p_h)
Bh = randn(rng_h, p_h, d_h)
panel_h = encode_to_panel(
    Xh, RepresentationSpec(:S, [:z1, :z2], S -> S * Bh),
)
lib_h = MechanismLibrary(;
    allowed_parents = Dict(:z1 => Symbol[], :y => [:z1]),
)
attach_lux_mechanism!(
    lib_h, :y; parents = [:z1], kind = :generative, hidden = 6, rng = rng_h,
)
mh = lib_h.mechanisms[:y]
loss_h = function (_ps)
    s = 0.0
    for i in 1:n_h
        s += abs2(generate_from_noise(mh, 0.0, [panel_h[:z1][i]]) - 1.5 * panel_h[:z1][i])
    end
    return s / n_h
end
timed!("phase1_l3_train") do
    train_mechanisms!(lib_h; loss = loss_h, maxiters = 200, lr = 0.05)
end
u_h = -0.25
y_fh = 1.5 * panel_h[:z1][1] + u_h
y_cfh = mechanism_counterfactual(mh, y_fh, [panel_h[:z1][1]], [0.0])
record!(:phase1_hand_off, "cf_under_do_z0"; expected = u_h, actual = y_cfh, tol = 0.4)
println("Phase 1→2b CF≈", round(y_cfh; digits = 3), " (expect ≈", u_h, ")")
```
